newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's tobacco company lifts profit 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's tobacco company lifts profit 24 percent.

text.p: Morocco's state tobacco company, Regie des Tabacs, made an operating profit of 672 million dirhams (about $75.5 million) in 1995, up 24 percent from the 542 million dirhams in 1994.

In its annual report released on Tuesday, the company said turnover was slightly down at 7.14 billion dirhams against 7.16 billion in 1994, affected by the unfavourable economical climate and change in tariffs in April 1995.
Local Moroccan tobacco products took 84.9 percent of the market, selling 12,170 tonnes, with a 16 percent increase in turnover of 4.7 billion dirhams for this part of the market.
Imports fell in value, producing a turnover in 1995 of 2.3 billion dirhams against three billion the year before.
